attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of agreement (e.g., Auto Loan, Mortgage, Business Loan). Helps classify the loan.

attributes.name: agreement_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement was created or signed. Useful for tracking timelines.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Jurisdiction (state/province/country) whose laws apply to the contract.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lending institution. Identifies who provides the funds.

attributes.name: lender_address
attributes.description: Full address of the lender. Useful for legal and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: borrower_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the borrower (individual or business). Identifies the party receiving the loan.

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Original principal borrowed. Core measure of loan size.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual percentage interest rate charged. Determines cost of borrowing.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Loan duration in months. Defines repayment period.

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: Scheduled amount due each month. Key for affordability checks.

attributes.name: collateral_vin
attributes.description: Vehicle Identification Number (if applicable). Unique ID for auto loans.

attributes.name: payment_due_day
attributes.description: Day of the month when payments are due. Needed for repayment tracking.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Amount charged if payment is late. Impacts borrower costs.

attributes.name: late_fee_trigger_days
attributes.description: Number of days after due date before late fee applies. Defines grace period.

attributes.name: acceleration_clause
attributes.description: Boolean (true/false). Indicates if the lender can demand full repayment if the borrower defaults. Critical for risk assessment.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of asset pledged (vehicle, real estate, equipment, etc.). Defines secured vs. unsecured loan.

attributes.name: collateral_description
attributes.description: Details of the pledged asset (e.g., “2023 Toyota Camry”). Helps identify the collateral.

attributes.name: signatures_required
attributes.description: List of parties required to sign (e.g., Lender, Borrower, Guarantor). Ensures enforceability of contract

attributes.name: ID_number
attributes.description: Unique identification number assigned to the loan agreement or borrower (e.g., contract ID, customer ID, or government-issued ID used for verification)**if theres none, just write N/A

parameters.content:
## New documents
Triggers when new docs is added to the folder.
The new docs is downloaded for use in the flow.
We select the best extraction process based on document type.

## Extract data from the document
We use OCR (top route) for PNG
We use LlamaParse (bottom route) for PDF, DOCX, TXT

## Clean Up Files
Once the documents has been successfully processed, we then move the file to the processed folder, and wipe it from the unprocessed folder.

## loan-agreement analysis Report
This agent will generate a report on your loan-agreement.

## Data Processing and Logging
Once we have extracted data from the invoice, we run it through a data extractor agent to pull out structured data. 
Once we have pulled the data, we log it in google sheets.
